name: Bynd Venture Capital
position: Bynd is an Iberian venture-capital firm operating since 2010, backing Portuguese and Spanish founders with world-class ambition. Its recent investments lean heavily into AI-native B2B software, with agents for sales, KYB onboarding, SEO and operations, alongside fintech, vertical SaaS and energy-transition platforms.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your recent investments read like a list of things I've built or bought: AI for inbound B2B sales (Uptail), AI agents for KYB onboarding (Sax), AI search and SEO (Reach) and fraud prevention (Fraudio).
summary: Bynd's newest companies are AI-native B2B products that sell to revenue, compliance and operations teams, and those are the teams I've worked in and for. I've shipped LLM features with evaluation sets and guardrails, scaled KYC and bot detection to 14M+ users at Pi Network, and set up pipeline, health-score and onboarding systems for a New York ad platform. Your sales, onboarding and fintech AI companies match that almost exactly, and I can work with them from Lisbon, in Portuguese, English or French.

reasons.title: KYC and KYB are my home ground
reasons.body: I owned KYC at Pi Network, from about 1M to 14M+ users. Sax automates KYB onboarding, Permisso captures financial data and Fraudio fights payment fraud: same problems, same buyers.

reasons.title: I've been the buyer of your sales AI
reasons.body: Uptail, Reach and AdCities sell into growth and revenue teams. I've built those teams' systems: pipeline stages, SLAs, health scores and ad-tech reporting.

reasons.title: AI agents, shipped with guardrails
reasons.body: Kapia, Noxus, Artiso and Assimetria live or die on LLM quality. I've shipped LLM features with evaluation sets and production guardrails.

vc_notes.thesis: AI-native B2B, fintech and vertical SaaS: the core of my track record.
vc_notes.stage: Investment stage isn't stated; the portfolio is mostly seed to Series A.
vc_notes.platform: A founder-resources hub; no talent or platform role found on the website.
